about: Practical issues met in production and the fix each one taught. Read by the migration factory (generator/porter), the Migration tool readiness check (hostscan.py) and the Weave Factory flow validator. Deterministic: every detection is a fixed rule, no model. Human summary: LESSONS.md next to this file.

where.generator: migration-factory/factory/lessons.py (rules + helper names), flow2bal.py, porter.py, logic.bal.txt
where.factory: traceit-middleware packages/weave-flow/src/lessons.ts, catalog.ts, describe.ts; apps/weave-runtime/src/validate.ts, engine/nodes.ts

lessons.title: Downstream sessions and tokens are reused, not re-created per call
lessons.why: Traveller-details calls each logged into Seaware separately: 10 parallel logins at 2.5-4.6 s each; one timed out after 36 s.
lessons.detect: A call whose path, name or configuration reads like login/token/auth/session runs on every request (or inside a loop) to the same backend, and its result is not kept between requests.
lessons.apply: Generator: a login whose inputs are only settings/literals is wrapped in session reuse (kept per backend for lessons.sessionReuseSeconds, identical parallel logins share one call, dropped when the backend answers 401/403/440). A login that depends on the caller's own data (per-user credentials) is never shared: TODO in the code and a readiness warning. Factory: a connection-level token is used; a login step inside a loop or per request is flagged.
lessons.test: factory tests: test_lessons.LoginReuse; hostscan tests: test_lessons.L1; weave-flow lessons.test.ts 'login in loop'

checks.title: A login/token call runs on every request
checks.fix: Keep the session or token and reuse it until it expires (generated: lessonsSession(...) with lessons.sessionReuseSeconds). Never share a login made with the caller's own credentials.

checks.title: A login/token call runs inside a loop or parallel branch
checks.fix: Log in once before the loop and pass the session to each item; or use the connection-level token.

lessons.title: Identical in-flight reads are coalesced; short-lived read results are cached
lessons.why: Identical parallel CMS requests and cabin-price requests sent 3x in parallel each hit the backend. A stuck in-flight mark hung callers. A Ballerina 'Kept & readonly' record literal read from a cache written by another copy crashed the handler (Java NPE) and callers hung.
lessons.detect: A read-only GET/lookup to a backend with no cache/share setting; coalescing code without a time limit on the in-flight mark; a '& readonly' record literal in cache code.
lessons.apply: Generator: every outbound GET goes through lessonsRead(...): identical in-flight reads share one call (lessons.shareIdenticalReads), answers kept lessons.readCacheSeconds (default 0 = off), key = backend + method + full URL + hash of all outbound headers (so per-user headers give per-user keys). Errors are never kept. The in-flight mark expires after lessons.inflightMaxSeconds, and waiters always get released. Cached values are built as a plain record, then .cloneReadOnly(). Redis-shared when the framework helper exists (flag MT_LESSONS_HELPERS=commons), memory otherwise. Factory: 'Cache answer for N seconds / share identical calls' on GET steps, default off.
lessons.test: factory tests: test_lessons.ReadSharing (generated text: cloneReadOnly, expiry, no error caching); hostscan tests: L2.readonly-literal; weave-runtime nodes.test cache/coalesce

checks.title: Backend reads are neither shared nor cached
checks.fix: Set lessons.shareIdenticalReads = true and, for answers that may be a little old, lessons.readCacheSeconds (e.g. 60). Never cache writes or per-user answers unless the key includes the user.

checks.title: A '& readonly' record literal is used for a cached/shared value
checks.fix: Build a plain record, then call .cloneReadOnly() on it. The readonly literal crashed the handler with a Java NPE in production.

checks.title: An in-flight mark has no time limit
checks.fix: Store the time the mark was set and let a waiter take over after inflightMaxSeconds; release the mark on error and on panic.

lessons.title: Side effects the caller does not wait for run after the answer, in the background
lessons.why: Sign-in waited 5.4 s for the e-mail send before answering.
lessons.detect: An e-mail/SMS/notification send in the request path whose result is not used by the response.
lessons.apply: Generator: a notification-like http:request whose result is only kept in a variable nothing reads (or is not used) runs with start runAsync after the answer path, with retries on connection failure (1 s, 3 s) and an error log 'background send failed' with backend/step (switch: lessons.backgroundSends). Factory: 'Send in background (don't wait)' option on e-mail/SMS/notification steps.
lessons.test: factory tests: test_lessons.BackgroundSend; hostscan: L3.notify-blocks-answer; weave-runtime background send test

checks.title: The answer waits for an e-mail/SMS/notification send
checks.fix: Send it in the background after the answer (generated: lessonsBackground(...), Factory: 'Send in background'), with retries and a visible failure log.

lessons.title: Every outbound call has an explicit timeout below the caller's; retries only for idempotent calls; bounded fan-out
lessons.why: Calls waited up to 60 s with no explicit limit; retrying non-idempotent calls risks double bookings/payments; unbounded parallel calls overloaded the same backend.
lessons.detect: A client or call without a timeout, a timeout >= the caller's timeout, a retry on POST/PATCH/payment without an idempotency key, a parallel loop with no bound to one backend.
lessons.apply: Generator: every DownstreamSettings gets an explicit timeoutSeconds in Config.toml.example (lessons.outboundTimeoutSeconds, default 20 < 30 s gateway timeout); ad-hoc URL clients use the same setting and are reused per base address; GET/HEAD/OPTIONS are retried on connection errors and 502/503/504 with lessons.retryDelaysSeconds = [1, 3]; other methods never. Factory: HTTP Request defaults timeoutMs 20000 and retries only for idempotent methods (or with an Idempotency-Key header) with retryDelaysMs [1000, 3000].
lessons.test: factory tests: test_lessons.Timeouts/Retries; hostscan: L4.*; weave-runtime validate tests

checks.title: An outbound call has no explicit timeout
checks.fix: Set timeoutSeconds for the backend (below the caller's timeout, e.g. 20 s when the gateway waits 30 s).

checks.title: An outbound timeout is not below the caller's timeout
checks.fix: Lower the backend timeout below the caller's (gateway) timeout so the service can still answer with a clear error.

checks.title: A non-idempotent call is retried
checks.fix: Retry only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS (or calls with an idempotency key). Payment and booking calls are never retried.

checks.title: Parallel calls to one backend are not bounded
checks.fix: Bound the parallel calls (e.g. at most 4 at once) or call sequentially.

lessons.title: Health checks: startup budget, tolerant liveness, separate readiness, safe rollouts
lessons.why: 1 s liveness probes with no start-up budget killed busy services in a loop all night (2026-11-18).
lessons.detect: Helm values (chart or per-service override) with liveness timeout < 5 s, liveness failureThreshold < 6, no startupProbe or < 5 min start budget, readiness path equal to liveness, rollout surge > 0 on a tight node.
lessons.apply: Chart deploy/helm/wso2-api has the right defaults since 2026-11-18; the generator writes no probe values; the readiness check flags any per-service override that weakens them.

checks.title: Liveness probe timeout is below 5 s
checks.fix: Remove the per-service probes override (the chart default is timeoutSeconds 5, failureThreshold 6).

checks.title: Liveness failureThreshold is below 6
checks.fix: Remove the per-service probes override or set failureThreshold: 6.

checks.title: No startup probe or less than 5 minutes to start
checks.fix: Keep the chart's startup probe (periodSeconds 10 x failureThreshold 30 = 5 min).

checks.title: Readiness and liveness use the same check
checks.fix: Readiness /health/ready, liveness /health/live.

checks.title: Rollout starts an extra copy on a tight node
checks.fix: strategy: { maxSurge: 0, maxUnavailable: 1 } (chart default).

lessons.title: Observability: started/finished per request, every backend call timed, correlation ID end to end
lessons.why: Without per-request and per-backend timing we could not find the 'unanswered' calls.
lessons.detect: No log with durationMs per request / per backend call; outbound requests without the correlation header.
lessons.apply: Generator: operation() logs 'request started' and 'request finished' with operation, status, durationMs, correlationId; every outbound call logs 'backend call' with backend, step, method, status, durationMs; the correlation ID header goes on every outbound request. Factory: runtime already logs per step; validation keeps it.

checks.title: Requests or backend calls are not logged with durationMs
checks.fix: Log started/finished per request with operation, status, durationMs, and every backend call with backend, step, status, durationMs (regenerate the service or use lessonsTimed).

checks.title: The correlation ID is not passed to backends
checks.fix: Send the x-correlation-id header on every outbound request.

lessons.title: Zoho CRM specifics
lessons.why: Zoho rejects "" for number/picklist/currency fields; unknown picklist values are rejected; search with 57 fields broke guest login (limit 50); a .sa token on the .in API gives 401; the header is 'Zoho-oauthtoken <token>'; inserts created duplicates where an upsert was needed.
lessons.detect: Calls to zohoapis/zoho.* hosts: body built without dropping empty strings, fields= list > 50, accounts and API data centres differ, Authorization 'Bearer' instead of 'Zoho-oauthtoken', POST /crm/vN/<Module> instead of /upsert with duplicate_check_fields.
lessons.apply: Generator: request bodies to Zoho go through lessonsDropEmpty (empty strings left out); search field lists over 50 and insert-instead-of-upsert are reported in PORTING.md/porting.json and as readiness warnings; data-centre mismatch is a readiness error. Factory: Zoho connector keeps OAuth2 refresh with the Zoho-oauthtoken prefix and drops empty strings.

checks.title: Empty strings may be sent to Zoho
checks.fix: Leave out fields whose value is "" (lessonsDropEmpty) before sending to Zoho.

checks.title: Zoho search asks for more than 50 fields
checks.fix: Ask for at most 50 fields per search (split the call or drop unused fields).

checks.title: Zoho accounts and API data centres differ
checks.fix: Use the same data centre for accounts.zoho.<dc> and www.zohoapis.<dc> (a .sa token on the .in API gives 401).

checks.title: Zoho Authorization header does not use 'Zoho-oauthtoken'
checks.fix: Send 'Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <access token>' (refreshed from the OAuth2 refresh token).

checks.title: Zoho records are inserted, not upserted
checks.fix: POST /crm/v2/<Module>/upsert with duplicate_check_fields so a repeat does not create a duplicate.

checks.title: Zoho picklist values must exist
checks.fix: Check picklist values against the Zoho field metadata before sending; map unknown values to an allowed one.

lessons.title: Configuration correctness
lessons.why: An undeclared config section broke start-up; two services asked for the same NodePort; a wrong CMS host caused 500s; TLS validation must stay explicit.
lessons.detect: Settings file sections no 'configurable' declares; duplicate nodePort in deploy/vm/values; backend hosts that do not resolve; tlsValidation=false or not explicit.
lessons.apply: Generator: Config.toml.example only carries declared sections and writes timeoutSeconds/tlsValidation explicitly per backend. Readiness: undeclared sections, NodePort clashes, unresolved hosts (when asked) and disabled TLS validation are findings.

checks.title: The settings file has a section the service does not declare
checks.fix: Remove the section or declare a matching configurable; an undeclared section stops the service at start-up.

checks.title: Two services use the same NodePort
checks.fix: Give this service a free NodePort (30100-30189) in deploy/vm/values/<api>.yaml.

checks.title: A backend host does not resolve
checks.fix: Correct the backend address in the settings file.

checks.title: TLS certificate validation is switched off
checks.fix: Set tlsValidation = true (give caCertPath for a private CA).

lessons.title: Idempotency and ordering for events
lessons.why: Repeated or out-of-order events created two identities for one message.
lessons.detect: A message/topic consumer with no event ID check, no stale-event check (version/timestamp) or that creates records without an upsert key.
lessons.apply: Generator: self-starting consumers carry a TODO and a readiness warning until an event ID and a stale-event rule exist. Factory: event triggers expose an idempotency key.

checks.title: An event consumer has no event-ID/stale-event check
checks.fix: Record each event ID (skip repeats), reject events older than the stored version, and upsert by a stable key so one message never makes two identities.

lessons.title: Operations safety (runbook)
lessons.why: Builds and browser tests overloaded the production VM on 2026-11-17/18; self-matching pgrep -f wait loops never ended; k8s/SQLite compaction ran without a health check.
lessons.detect: Runbook and tool checks, not generator output.
lessons.apply: Heavy builds/tests run under systemd-run --scope -p CPUQuota=100% nice -n 19 ionice -c3, never during working hours and never when load > 20; no Playwright on the production VM; no 'while pgrep -f <pattern>' loops (they match themselves); compaction is followed by a health check.
lessons.test: runbook (LESSONS.md); hostscan flags 'pgrep -f' wait loops in service scripts

checks.title: A script waits with 'pgrep -f' (matches itself)
checks.fix: Wait on a PID or a lock file (flock) instead of a pgrep -f pattern.
